events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances As Hopes Of U.S.-Iran Deal Diminish After Trump's Message
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value edged higher on Thursday as oil supply disruption concerns returned to markets after U.S. President Donald Trump stated that the U.S. is no longer interested in a deal with Iran. With worries of inflation and global rate hikes returning, expectations among investors about an early reopening of the Strait of Hormuz vanished.

events.title: New Zealand Manufacturing PMI Fades To 54.9 In October - BusinessNZ
events.description: The manufacturing sector in New Zealand continued to expand in October, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from BusinessNZ revealed on Friday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 54.9.

events.title: South Korea Export Prices Surge 36.7% On Year In October
events.description: Export prices in South Korea spiked 36.7 percent on year in October, the Bank of Korea said on Friday - slowing from 41.3 percent in September.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Moderately Higher
events.description: The Switzerland stock market closed on a firm note on Thursday after moving in a narrow range modestly above the flat line throught the session session.

events.title: Major European Markets Close Modestly Higher
events.description: European markets pared early gains and despite slipping into negative territory a little past mid afternoon, recovered to close modestly higher on Thursday thanks to some brisk buying at several counters in the final hour.

events.title: Canadian Market Remains Weak Despite Coming Off Early Lows
events.description: Despite coming off early lows, the Canadian market is down firmly in negative territory a little past noon on Thursday with stocks from materials and healthcare sectors continuing to reel under selling pressure.

events.title: U.S. Existing Home Sales Plunge To Sixteen-Year Low In October
events.description: Partly reflecting the impact of high mortgage rates, the National Association of Realtors released a report on Thursday showing a steep drop in existing home sales in the U.S. in the month of October. NAR said existing home sales plunged by 5.5 percent to an annual rate of 3.75 million in October after jumping by 1 percent to a revised rate of 3.97 million in September.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Rebound More Than Expected To 200,000
events.description: A report released by the Labor Department on Thursday showed first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits rebounded by more than expected in the week ended November 7th. The Labor Department said initial jobless claims climbed to 200,000, an increase of 9,000 from the previous week's revised level of 191,000.

events.title: Bay Street Headed For Weak Start
events.description:
Lower U.S. and Canadian futures and weak precious metals prices indicate a lower opening for stocks on Bay Street Thursday morning. Oil prices have rebounded, paring early losses.

Nasdaq futures are down sharply, with Nvidia shares plunging more than 7% in premarket trading.

events.title: U.S. Initial Jobless Claims Climb More Than Expected
events.description: A report released by the Labor Department on Thursday showed first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits rebounded by more than expected in the week ended November 7th.

events.title: Siemens Stock Gains On Strong Q4, Dividend Hike, Positive Outlook
events.description: Shares of Siemens AG were gaining around 3 percent in the German trading after the company reported Thursday higher profit, revenues and orders in its fourth quarter, supported mainly by high demand for electrification, digitalization and Industrial AI, which is expected to drive future growth. Further, the German conglomerate raised dividend, issued positive outlook for fiscal 2027.

events.title: FTSE 100 Hits 4-Week High On Earnings, Growth Data
events.description: The FTSE 100 advanced Thursday to 10,874.51, up 0.36%, as positive earnings updates and UK GDP growth of 0.7% quarterly boosted sentiment. Mining stocks lagged while luxury and retail outperformed on solid results.

events.title: CAC 40 Moderately Higher As Oil Prices Drop
events.description: French stocks climbed higher on Thursday, extending gains to a fourth straight session, as easing oil prices helped ease concerns about inflation.
